HideAtBreakpoint.reason: HideAtBreakpoint is not a React component — it's a documentation-only Storybook 'Helpers' page demonstrating pure SCSS mixins (hide-at-sm/md/lg/xlg/max from @carbon/styles/scss/utilities/hide-at-breakpoint) applied via plain CSS class names. There is no component API (no props, no JS logic, no exported React component) to give an Ember counterpart; consumers apply the same @carbon/styles mixins directly in their own SCSS, which already works today via this addon's existing @carbon/styles dependency.
